sentences.text:
Opposite Party/s
 ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Anshu Dhar Sharma
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Sanjay Kumar Tiwary
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Anjani Kumar Sharan
 Oral Order
3 19-06-2023
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.

The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Belchi P.S. Case No. 94/2021 dated 24.12.2021, registered for the offence punishable under Sections 406 and 420 of the Indian Penal Code pending in the Court of learned A.C.J.M., Barh.
After some arguments, learned counsel for the petitioner seeks permission to withdraw this application.
Accordingly, the instant application is dismissed as withdrawn.

However, if the petitioner surrenders before the learned Court below within a period of six weeks from today Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.75327 of 2022(3) dt.19-06-2023 and seeks regular bail,
the learned Court below would pass the order, preferably, on the same day, without being prejudiced by this order.

(Anjani Kumar Sharan, J) ajay/-
